review: Visual inspection of every full-resolution generated image; compared with current recent done images and the evolution-line anchor.

anchor.evidence: Both boots and head remain inside the frame; two intact gloved hands, violet updo, black pearl circlet and curled pink drapes. Compared with Spoink, Roserade, Cranidos and Torkoal: fuller cheeks and lips, sloping relaxed eyes, less angular nose than Cranidos; softer chin than the proposed design is recorded, not replaced.

forms.evidence: Heavy adds concentric overlapping shoulder, waist and shin plates; mobility has swept blade-shaped fins. Three openings preserve each base pose and open mechanical seams with pink psychic light; no new carried weapons.

identity.evidence: Purple chignon and long loose strands, violet eyes and full lips persist without the armor.

activity_location.evidence: Ring ceiling lights and metal sculptures establish the gallery; both hands hold the circular clasp and clutch.

garments_exposure.evidence: Off-shoulder plum blouse and pink tailored shorts expose back, shoulders and thighs.

anatomy_text.evidence: Two connected arms and plausible gripping fingers; gallery visitors are distant blurred silhouettes. No legible lettering or labels on the clasp, frames or walls.

chosen_composition.evidence: Over-shoulder turn is present, but the crop extends to mid-thigh rather than the selected waist-up.

expression.evidence: Soft parted lips and relaxed lids read calm rather than distinctly confident.

identity.evidence: Same purple updo, loose long strands and violet eyes.

activity_location.evidence: Warm brass-and-black dressing alcove with a jewelry tray; both hands adjust a pearl clasp.

garments_exposure.evidence: Mandarin collar, frog fastenings and matching plum silk shorts form the qipao-inspired set; shoulders, abdomen and thighs remain uncovered.

anatomy_text.evidence: Two hands meet at the clasp without an additional wrist; perfume bottles, jewelry box and mirror surround have ornament, no letters.

chosen_composition.evidence: Nearly frontal standing body, head-to-thigh crop, portrait compression.

expression.evidence: Relaxed brows and slightly parted mouth rather than a firmly proud smile.

identity.evidence: Purple chignon, free strands and same face; wind moves the long hair.

activity_location.evidence: She strides at the foamy waterline holding sandals; cliffs and sand show the cove.

garments_exposure.evidence: Green bandeau bikini leaves shoulders, abdomen and legs exposed.

anatomy_text.evidence: Two natural arms; one hand grips sandal straps, the other hangs open. Toes meet the surf without extra feet. No text on sandals or swimwear.

chosen_composition.evidence: Full body is present, but the torso is a front three-quarter rather than pure side view.

expression.evidence: Half-lidded gaze and slightly open lips read composed rather than an obvious exhale of relief.

diversity.evidence: Compared actual images side by side. Gallery over-shoulder clutch handling in blouse/shorts, frontal jewelry adjustment in a structured silk set, and a full-body walking bikini beach scene differ in activity, garment structure and body direction. Recent done sets show seated dock/kitchen/music, bed/map/laundry, and orchard/racing/bead craft activities respectively. Reserved Rampardos/Shieldon images were not yet published for visual comparison.
